ext_description.message: Lists the links, images and media on a page and downloads the ones you pick, with a queue and file name rules.

action_title.message: File Downloader: list the links on this page

type_none_title.message: Addresses without a file extension, such as generated download links

cap_notice.message: Showing the first $1 of $2 matches; narrow the filter to see the rest. Select shown still ticks all $2.

tokens_hint.message: Tokens: {name} {ext} {text} {title} {host} {n} {n:3} {date} {time}. A / in the folder makes subfolders; an empty folder saves straight into Downloads.

queue_title.message: Add to the downloads without starting; start them later on the Downloads page

scan_too_big.message: The list of this page is too big to keep.

err_tpl_too_long.message: A folder or file name template may have at most 200 characters.

note_unread.message: Frames from other sites that could not be read: $1.

note_skipped.message: Addresses that cannot be downloaded were left out: $1.

show_gone.message: Chrome no longer lists this download. It was saved as: $1

show_missing.message: The file is no longer there: $1

warn_danger.message: Chrome is holding this file as possibly dangerous. Keep opens Chrome's question; Cancel discards the file.

warn_html.message: This is a web page, not a file: the site may have asked you to sign in.

hint_canceled_early.message: Chrome canceled this before any data arrived. If Chrome is set to ask where to save each file, turn that off in its download settings and click Retry.

rows_capped.message: Showing $1 of $2 files: running, paused and failed ones first.

setting_range.message: Enter a whole number from $1 to $2.
